items.summary_en: A concert this Friday at the Radio MEC Concert Hall honors Brazilian composer Radamés Gnattali. His pieces are performed by the Abstrai Ensemble and the UFRJ Saxophone Group. Both groups are led by saxophonist and professor Pedro Bittencourt.

items.summary_en: Lamine Yamal, a world champion with Spain, surprised fans by wearing a Colombia shirt. He visited the Flower Fair in Medellin and joined a show by singer Ryan Castro in Comuna 13.

items.raw_excerpt: Much more than just the 'affordable Tuscany,' residents say this central Italian region has a distinct identity and appeal of its own – without the crowds.
items.summary_en: Residents say Le Marche is much more than just an affordable Tuscany. This region in central Italy has mountains, sea, and cheap property. It has its own identity and charm, without the tourist crowds.

items.title_original: Mountains, sea, cheap property: What it’s really like living in Le Marche

items.raw_excerpt: Being able to partake in cakes is a great way to connect with Danes, who have a passion for baked goods. Fortunately, there are plenty of ways to join in if you have allergies.
items.summary_en: Danes love baked goods, and sharing cake is a great way to connect with them. If you have allergies, there are still many ways to join in. Here is how and where to enjoy cake safely.

items.raw_excerpt: It is a paradox in a country which is almost synonymous with the word ‘cheese’ that an increasing number of consumers opt for imported, rather than domestic, product.
items.summary_en: Swiss consumers are buying more foreign cheese instead of domestic cheese. This is surprising because Switzerland is almost synonymous with cheese. The trend is growing even in a country famous for its own cheese.
items.summary_ko: 스위스 소비자들이 국산 치즈 대신 수입 치즈를 더 많이 사고 있습니다. 치즈와 동의어나 다름없는 나라에서 벌어지는 역설입니다. 이 같은 경향은 점점 커지고 있습니다.
items.title_en: Why do Swiss shoppers prefer foreign cheese?
items.title_ko: 스위스 사람들이 외국 치즈를 선호하는 이유
items.title_original: Why do the Swiss prefer to buy foreign cheese?

items.raw_excerpt: One of them is the size of a small bird.

items.raw_excerpt: Renting an apartment as a foreigner in Denmark has plenty of pitfalls. These tips are worth knowing when it comes to paying a deposit and getting as much of it back as you can.
items.summary_en: Moving to Denmark and renting an apartment can be tricky for foreigners. You need to know about the deposit and how to get most of it back. These four tips will help you with paying and recovering your deposit.

items.raw_excerpt: Sunday is a traditional day of rest in Switzerland and much of the country pretty much shuts down and there are also tight rules for what people can do.
items.summary_en: In Switzerland, Sunday is a traditional day of rest. Most of the country shuts down on that day. There are also strict rules about what people are allowed to do.

items.raw_excerpt: Sistema Alerta Rio prevê ventos acima de 90 km/h em algumas regiões, especialmente no litoral, até domingo (9).
items.summary_en: Rio de Janeiro canceled classes this Friday because of strong wind. The Alerta Rio system says winds may reach over 90 km/h in some areas. The strongest winds are expected along the coast until Sunday.

items.raw_excerpt: Ametista Nunes participou do movimento Poetas na Praça, formado por estudantes que transformaram a poesia em marco de resistência política, cultural e social.
items.summary_en: Poet Ametista Nunes is from Bahia, Brazil. She joined the Poetas na Praça (Poets in the Square) movement started by students. The group made poetry a symbol of political, cultural, and social resistance.

items.raw_excerpt: Westminster Council is under fire as part of its plans to update a licensing policy. Why?
items.summary_en: Westminster Council is facing criticism over its plans to update a licensing policy. The row is about 'vertical drinking'. That means pubs and bars where people stand and drink instead of sitting.

items.raw_excerpt: A glass of sangria is almost synonymous with summer in Portugal. Served everywhere from beach bars to family barbecues, it's one of the country's best-known drinks. But what many people don't realise is that the name "sangria" is legally protected across the European Union.
items.summary_en: A glass of sangria is a summer symbol in Portugal. It is served everywhere, from beach bars to family barbecues. But few people know the name 'sangria' is legally protected across the European Union.
items.summary_ko: 상그리아 한 잔은 포르투갈 여름을 상징합니다. 해변 바부터 가족 바비큐까지 어디서나 즐기는 대표 음료죠. 하지만 '상그리아'라는 이름이 유럽연합 전역에서 법적으로 보호되고 있다는 사실을 아는 사람은 많지 않습니다.
items.title_en: Only Portugal and Spain can sell 'sangria' under that name

items.raw_excerpt: Gadag district eligible for drought declaration as rainfall deficit reaches 31%, impacting crops and farmers, says Minister Rayareddi.

items.raw_excerpt: Looking to enjoy a relaxing holiday on the beach in France? Here are the rules you should know before setting up your umbrella.

items.raw_excerpt: The airport ritual of unpacking your hand luggage could be on its way out as Keflavík prepares for new CT security scanners.

items.raw_excerpt: Trying to get anything done in France in August can be frustrating as the country shifts into holiday modes and shops and offices close up - but Emma Pearson argues that this tradition reveals important values and should be defended - even against France's own politicians.
items.summary_en: Almost everything in France closes in August for summer holidays. Shops and offices go quiet, and some people find this frustrating. A writer argues this tradition is valuable and should be kept.

items.title_en: Why France shuts down for all of August
